ayahs.text: BEHOLD, from on high have We bestowed this [divine writ] on Night of Destiny.
ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

ayahs.text: And what could make thee conceive what it is, that Night of Destiny?
The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months:
ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ

ayahs.text: in hosts descend in it the angels, bearing divine inspiration by their Sustainer's leave; from all [evil] that may happen
ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ

ayahs.text: does it make secure, until the rise of dawn.
